{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794723920694,"sessionID":"ses_e222a8d55ffe1tq3QHfS4aTBdx","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"vXtGHgWADOmnN4be","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes.py","content":"import math\n\nsuspects = [\"e04\", \"e10\", \"e13\", \"e16\", \"e19\", \"e27\"]\n\n# Access logs for Research suspects across Days 1..7 (all 6 held >=1 doc on every day 1..7!)\n# Wait: verify! Research got d1-1 on Day 1, so all 6 held >=1 doc on Days 1..7!\n# Let's count (daytime_false, after_hours_true) for each of the 6 suspects across Days 1..7:\nlogs_by_day = {\n    1: [\n        (\"e04\", False),\n        (\"e10\", False), (\"e10\", False),\n        (\"e16\", False),\n        (\"e27\", False), (\"e27\", False),\n    ],\n    2: [\n        (\"e10\", True),\n        (\"e13\", True),\n        (\"e16\", False),\n        (\"e19\", False), (\"e19\", False), (\"e19\", False),\n    ],\n    3: [\n        (\"e04\", False),\n        (\"e10\", True),\n        (\"e13\", False),\n        (\"e16\", False),\n        (\"e27\", True),\n    ],\n    4: [\n        (\"e04\", False),\n        (\"e13\", False),\n        (\"e16\", False),\n        (\"e19\", False),\n    ],\n    5: [\n        (\"e04\", False),\n        (\"e10\", False),\n        (\"e13\", False),\n        (\"e16\", False),\n        (\"e27\", False),\n    ],\n    6: [\n        (\"e04\", False), (\"e04\", False),\n        (\"e13\", False),\n        (\"e16\", False), (\"e16\", False),\n        (\"e19\", False), (\"e19\", False),\n    ],\n    7: [\n        (\"e04\", False),\n        (\"e13\", False), (\"e13\", False),\n        (\"e16\", False),\n    ],\n}\n\n# Eligible non-mole non-decoy employees holding >=1 doc on each day:\n# Day 1: 20 total doc holders (Sales 6 + Research 6 + Eng 8); minus mole (1) and decoy e17 (1) = 18\n# Day 2: 33 total doc holders (all except Legal 7); minus mole (1) and decoy (1) = 31\n# Days 3..7: all 40 hold >=1 doc; minus mole (1) and decoy (1) = 38\nnon_mole_decoy_holders = {1: 18, 2: 31, 3: 38, 4: 38, 5: 38, 6: 38, 7: 38}\n\n# Interviews for the 6 suspects: list of booleans (True = evasive, False = cooperative)\n# Let's double check every single interview we conducted!\ninterviews = {\n    \"e04\": [\n        False, # D1 recent_documents: cooperative\n        False, # D5 access_needs: cooperative\n        True,  # D6 contacts_outside: \"I'd rather not go through my personal life, if that's okay.\" -> EVASIVE\n        True,  # D7 workload: \"Can we talk about this another time? I've got a lot going on.\" -> EVASIVE\n    ],\n    \"e10\": [\n        True,  # D2 recent_documents: \"Whatever got sent to me. I skim most of it.\" -> EVASIVE\n        False, # D3 contacts_outside: cooperative\n        False, # D4 workload: cooperative (\"A bit stretched; I stayed late twice...\")\n        False, # D5 access_needs: cooperative\n        False, # D6 contacts_outside: cooperative\n        False, # D6 recent_documents: cooperative\n        False, # D7 workload: cooperative\n    ],\n    \"e13\": [\n        True,  # D3 recent_documents: \"I see a lot of documents...\" -> EVASIVE\n        False, # D5 access_needs: cooperative\n        False, # D6 contacts_outside: cooperative\n        False, # D7 workload: cooperative\n    ],\n    \"e16\": [\n        False, # D4 recent_documents: cooperative\n        True,  # D5 access_needs: \"Is there a problem with my access? I'd rather not lose anything.\" -> EVASIVE\n        False, # D6 contacts_outside: cooperative\n        False, # D7 workload: cooperative\n    ],\n    \"e19\": [\n        False, # D4 recent_documents: cooperative\n        False, # D5 access_needs: cooperative\n        False, # D6 contacts_outside: cooperative\n        True,  # D7 workload: \"Can we talk about this another time?...\" -> EVASIVE\n    ],\n    \"e27\": [\n        False, # D4 recent_documents: cooperative\n        True,  # D5 access_needs: \"I need whatever access I need to do my job.\" -> EVASIVE\n        True,  # D6 contacts_outside: \"I talk to people, like everyone does. Nothing worth mentioning.\" -> EVASIVE\n        True,  # D7 workload: \"It varies. Some days are late, some aren't.\" -> EVASIVE\n    ],\n}\n\ndef pois_logpmf(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\nfor extra_random_frame in [0.0, 1.0]:\n    print(f\"=== Extra DSL random frame per day: {extra_random_frame} ===\")\n    log_post = {s: 0.0 for s in suspects}\n    for m in suspects:\n        lp = 0.0\n        for d in range(1, 8):\n            day_logs = logs_by_day[d]\n            for s in suspects:\n                f_cnt = sum(1 for emp, ah in day_logs if emp == s and not ah)\n                t_cnt = sum(1 for emp, ah in day_logs if emp == s and ah)\n                if s == m:\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(f_cnt, 0.7)\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(t_cnt, 0.3)\n                else:\n                    frame_rate = 1.0 / non_mole_decoy_holders[d] + extra_random_frame / (non_mole_decoy_holders[d] + 1)\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(f_cnt, 0.9)\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(t_cnt, 0.1 + frame_rate)\n        # Interviews\n        for s in suspects:\n            for ev in interviews[s]:\n                if s == m:\n                    lp += math.log(0.24 if ev else 0.76)\n                else:\n                    lp += math.log(0.20 if ev else 0.80)\n        log_post[m] = lp\n    max_lp = max(log_post.values())\n    probs = {s: math.exp(lp - max_lp) for s, lp in log_post.items()}\n    tot = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {s: v / tot for s, v in probs.items()}\n    for s in sorted(suspects, key=lambda x: -probs[x]):\n        f_tot = sum(sum(1 for emp, ah in logs_by_day[d] if emp == s and not ah) for d in range(1, 8))\n        t_tot = sum(sum(1 for emp, ah in logs_by_day[d] if emp == s and ah) for d in range(1, 8))\n        ev_tot = sum(interviews[s])\n        print(f\"  {s}: P={probs[s]:.4f}  (daytime={f_tot}, after_hours={t_tot}, evasive={ev_tot}/{len(interviews[s])})\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/bayes.py","time":{"start":1794723920676,"end":1794723920691}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dde1bb11001ziRQsE9aN4LIur","sessionID":"ses_e222a8d55ffe1tq3QHfS4aTBdx","messageID":"msg_1dde083b8001aidBSb7xeVF7iE"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794724202412,"sessionID":"ses_e222a8d55ffe1tq3QHfS4aTBdx","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"jiefd64jYXa49occ","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes.py","content":"import math\n\nsuspects = [\"e10\", \"e27\", \"e13\"] # ONLY recipients of c8 who also received d1-1 & d2-3!\n\nlogs_by_day = {\n    1: [(\"e10\", False), (\"e10\", False), (\"e27\", False), (\"e27\", False)],\n    2: [(\"e10\", True), (\"e13\", True)],\n    3: [(\"e10\", True), (\"e13\", False), (\"e27\", True)],\n    4: [(\"e13\", False)],\n    5: [(\"e10\", False), (\"e13\", False), (\"e27\", False)],\n    6: [(\"e13\", False)],\n    7: [(\"e13\", False), (\"e13\", False)],\n    8: [(\"e27\", False)],\n    9: [], # NONE of e10, e27, e13 had ANY access on Day 9!\n}\n\nnon_mole_decoy_holders = {1: 18, 2: 31, 3: 38, 4: 38, 5: 38, 6: 38, 7: 38, 8: 38, 9: 38}\n\ninterviews = {\n    \"e10\": [\n        True,  # D2 recent_documents\n        False, # D3 contacts_outside\n        False, # D4 workload\n        False, # D5 access_needs\n        False, # D6 contacts_outside\n        False, # D6 recent_documents\n        False, # D7 workload\n        True,  # D8 recent_documents (\"I'd have to check. I don't really keep track of what I open.\")\n        False, # D9 access_needs (\"My access is a bit broad...\")\n    ],\n    \"e13\": [\n        True,  # D3 recent_documents\n        False, # D5 access_needs\n        False, # D6 contacts_outside\n        False, # D7 workload\n        False, # D8 recent_documents\n        False, # D9 access_needs\n    ],\n    \"e27\": [\n        False, # D4 recent_documents\n        True,  # D5 access_needs\n        True,  # D6 contacts_outside\n        True,  # D7 workload\n        False, # D8 recent_documents\n        False, # D9 access_needs\n    ],\n}\n\ncanary_lr = {\n    \"e10\": 0.95,\n    \"e27\": 0.025,\n    \"e13\": 0.025,\n}\n\ndef pois_logpmf(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\nfor extra_random_frame in [0.0, 1.0]:\n    print(f\"=== Extra DSL random frame per day: {extra_random_frame} ===\")\n    log_post = {}\n    for m in suspects:\n        lp = math.log(canary_lr[m])\n        for d in range(1, 10):\n            day_logs = logs_by_day[d]\n            for s in suspects:\n                f_cnt = sum(1 for emp, ah in day_logs if emp == s and not ah)\n                t_cnt = sum(1 for emp, ah in day_logs if emp == s and ah)\n                if s == m:\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(f_cnt, 0.7)\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(t_cnt, 0.3)\n                else:\n                    frame_rate = 1.0 / non_mole_decoy_holders[d] + extra_random_frame / (non_mole_decoy_holders[d] + 1)\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(f_cnt, 0.9)\n                    lp += pois_logpmf(t_cnt, 0.1 + frame_rate)\n        for s in suspects:\n            for ev in interviews[s]:\n                if s == m:\n                    lp += math.log(0.24 if ev else 0.76)\n                else:\n                    lp += math.log(0.20 if ev else 0.80)\n        log_post[m] = lp\n    max_lp = max(log_post.values())\n    probs = {s: math.exp(lp - max_lp) for s, lp in log_post.items()}\n    tot = sum(probs.values())\n    probs = {s: v / tot for s, v in probs.items()}\n    for s in suspects:\n        print(f\"  {s}: P={probs[s]:.5f}\")\n    p10 = probs[\"e10\"]\n    for true_V in [0.70, 0.65]:\n        ev_now = p10 * true_V + (1 - p10) * (-1.0)\n        print(f\"  EV(accuse e10 now | true_V={true_V:.2f}) = {ev_now:.5f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes.py","exists":true,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/bayes.py","time":{"start":1794724202399,"end":1794724202410}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dde607930017CnBaskIGWsaNE","sessionID":"ses_e222a8d55ffe1tq3QHfS4aTBdx","messageID":"msg_1dde4f266001wQhlQUhr2UhaDv"}}

{"type":"text","timestamp":1794724265010,"sessionID":"ses_e222a8d55ffe1tq3QHfS4aTBdx","part":{"id":"prt_1dde6e9f8001BFmer0Kk7h1NR1","messageID":"msg_1dde6d57c001Gtt4hmdEq7yboD","sessionID":"ses_e222a8d55ffe1tq3QHfS4aTBdx","type":"text","text":"Accused **`e10` (Nea Jarvinen, Research lead)** on Day 10 with visible `V = 0.70` (`P(e10) ≈ 98.8%`).\n\n### Key Evidence\n1. **Decoy Elimination:** Message search on Day 2 identified `e17` as the angry decoy (`P(mole = e17) = 0`).\n2. **Document Intersection (40 → 6 suspects):** Leaked documents `d1-1` (Sales + Research) and `d2-3` (Engineering + Research) narrowed the mole with 100% certainty to the 6 Research employees (`e04, e10, e13, e16, e19, e27`), corroborated by subsequent leaks of `d3-3` and `d5-1`.\n3. **Targeted Canary Hit (6 → 3 → 1):** Canary `c8` was planted on `{e10: v1, e27: v2, e13: v3}` (padded with 3 excluded Finance employees `{e01, e05, e11}` to keep recipient count at 6). `c8` surfaced on Day 10 with **`variant: \"v1\"`**, eliminating `e04, e16, e19` completely and giving a 38:1 likelihood ratio for `e10` over `e27` and `e13`.\n4. **Access Logs & Interviews:** Across Days 1–9, `e10` logged multiple `after_hours: true` accesses, low daytime accesses (consistent with Poisson `0.7` vs `0.9`), and 4 evasive interview responses (including 2/4 on Day 10), bringing `P(e10)` to ~98.8%.","time":{"start":1794724260344,"end":1794724265004}}}
